dedupe_keys.name: matsbha physics based model and ai integration to quantify the water energy ghg footprint of data center v1 0 0 data center water energy ghg modeling framework

description: The maintainer matsbha publishes a physics-based modelling package for data-centre water consumption, energy use and greenhouse-gas impacts. The initial research release includes source code for both air-cooled and water-cooled facilities and describes an integration with artificial intelligence. Zenodo preserves version 1.0.0 from August 2026 as a ZIP snapshot of the linked GitHub repository under CC BY 4.0, free of charge. The deposit directs users to the repository README for equations, assumptions, input requirements and execution instructions. The landing-page metadata do not identify a calibration facility, observation period, simulation time step or complete input schema; these details remain unknown in this review. Potential reuse is comparison of cooling configurations and their water-energy dependencies. No model execution or performance validation was undertaken, and no related catalogue record is explicitly identified.
